causal_checks: When released, the ball starts moving downhill along the ramp, not uphill or sideways.
The ball's displacement down the ramp increases over time from its initial position.
The ball's speed increases as it descends the inclined ramp.
The ball remains supported by and visually in contact with the ramp until it reaches the ramp end.
The ramp and support blocks do not move in response to the ball's release.
If the ball reaches the lower edge, it exits in the downhill direction with continuing motion.
controlled_variables: Ramp angle remains fixed at 20.0 degrees.
Ramp position, length, width, and surface geometry remain unchanged.
Camera remains fixed with no pan, zoom, or cut.
The red ball remains the same size, shape, color, and material appearance.
The lab background, support blocks, tabletop, notebook edge, and board remain static.
No additional objects or hands enter the scene.
expected_spec.expected_response: After release, gravity causes the red ball to accelerate down the ramp along the ramp surface. It should begin from rest at the upper position, roll or slide smoothly downhill in the direction of the lower end, stay in contact with the ramp while on it, and move faster as it descends. If it reaches the lower end within the rollout, it should leave the ramp or continue off the end consistently with its downward velocity rather than stopping or reversing without contact.
failure_modes: Ball moves uphill, sideways off the ramp, or teleports.
Ball accelerates unrealistically, reverses direction without collision, or stops abruptly mid-ramp.
Ball floats above the ramp, penetrates through it, or loses contact before the ramp end without a physical cause.
Ramp, supports, tabletop, or background shift, deform, or disappear.
Camera moves or cuts to a different view.
Ball changes color, size, shape, or identity.
Additional forces, hands, tools, or objects appear and affect the motion.
expected_spec.intervention: Release the red ball from rest near the upper end of the ramp without pushing or lifting it.
protected_anchors: Red ball is initially near the upper portion of the gray ramp.
Ramp is a straight gray inclined plane descending from left/back toward right/front.
Ramp angle is 20.0 degrees and does not visibly change.
Scene remains a school physics lab or classroom measurement setup.
Fixed three-quarter measurement camera perspective is preserved.
Neutral lab context and isolated saturated red target appearance are preserved.
expected_spec.target_system: A red ball on a rigid instrumented lab ramp inclined at 20.0 degrees in a fixed three-quarter classroom-lab view.
